fields.definition: Urgent airway concern for this follow-up encounter: stridor or breathing difficulty suggesting laryngeal dystonia. Present means clinician-recorded stridor, breathing difficulty, or suspected laryngeal involvement; Absent means assessment found none. This saved structured input drives the parallel urgent banner independently of estimation latency and also informs the AirwayConcern CPT context; the banner never waits for inference and never shows a computed risk percentage.
fields.operationalization: Present requires clinician-recorded stridor or breathing difficulty with encounter/window attribution and emergency assessment routing; Absent requires assessment finding no airway concern; unknown/not_assessed/missing/conflict pauses. Source-approved urgent message shows without waiting for inference. BN-11 AirwayConcern node semantics (estimation context for AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway) are distinct from the parallel banner mechanism (saved-input rendering independent of inference). Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Acute dystonia episode phase for this follow-up encounter: active, resolved, or no episode. Active means present sustained involuntary contractions with abnormal postures (neck twisting, jaw spasm, tongue protrusion, sustained eye deviation/oculogyric crisis, abnormal limb/trunk postures, throat involvement); Resolved means a prior episode has resolved and post-resolution/recurrence-prevention review applies with retained Dx context; NoEpisode means assessment found no acute dystonia episode.
fields.operationalization: Active requires clinician-recorded sustained postures with distribution/persistence review, medication timeline within days of initiation/escalation or reduction of EPS-preventive medication, and exclusions considered (catatonia, primary neurological/medical cause, tardive movement disorder); Resolved requires documented prior episode with resolution and retained Dx item context for continuation review; NoEpisode requires assessment finding no such episode. Unknown/not_assessed/missing/conflict pauses. Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria item responses (5 items, no total) are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; completion required only when phase is Active; NoEpisode/not_assessed have no completion requirement; a missing Dx item never becomes a negative finding. Severity is independent clinician-reviewed mild|moderate|severe, never derived from a total. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether the acute dystonia episode is associated with antipsychotic exposure in this follow-up context, after alternative explanations are considered.
fields.operationalization: Established requires documented antipsychotic exposure with onset within days of initiation or dose escalation (or after reduction of EPS-preventive medication, including dopamine-blocking antiemetics) and alternative contributors reviewed (catatonia, primary neurological/medical cause, tardive movement disorder; symptoms preceding exposure, unexplained focal findings, or progression unrelated to medication changes warrant further investigation); NotEstablished requires assessment finding no such association or an alternative explanation. Unknown pauses. Exposure agents and windows only; no dose/route/frequency/active-stopped/free-text fields. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Scenario concern about cognitive, urinary, bowel, ocular, cardiac, thermoregulatory or other anticholinergic effects for this encounter.
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician records a patient-specific anticholinergic safety concern (dry mouth, blurred vision, angle-closure glaucoma risk, constipation/fecal impaction, tachycardia, urinary retention, thermoregulation effects, impaired learning/memory, slowed cognition, toxicity with delirium/somnolence/hallucinations) with attribution; Absent means review found none. Unknown pauses. Safety inputs are structured categories only; current product labeling is consulted without copying prescribing details as activation metadata. Page notes are never mapping input.

purpose: Isolated S36 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Episode Active/Resolved/NoEpisode gates applicability with reviewed severity; Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria item responses are measurement context only pending the complete reviewed source; no total score and no treatment threshold.
retained_history_v1: Twelve original v1 fields and runtime remain unchanged; this separately versioned adjunct proposes 8 additional CPT-context categories for F4, none approved.
